'''Reldar Kandik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Kandik served with the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]] as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in [[Rana Squadron]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While on a mission on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Kandik and the rest of his squadron were shot down, and Kandik was the only survivor.<ref name="TOR" />

==Tarisian Mission==
Reldar Kandik was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He served in the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]], as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the all-Duros [[Rana Squadron]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], Kandik and his squadron were assigned to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to perform a mission.<ref name="TOR" />

Rana Squadron was tasked with destroying a captured [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|Taris Reclamation]] base in order to protect the confidential data of [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] tactics. However, the Death's Claw pirates attacked Rana Squadron and destroyed the fighters, and Kandik was shot down. The lone survivor of this mission, Kandik was stranded on the shores of [[Lake Brell]]. He met a Republic-allied individual, who offered to help complete the mission when they heard of Kandik's predicament. The individual destroyed three of the base's power couplings to gain access to the computers, fighting their way through the pirates. After the individual destroyed the sensitive information, Kandik thanked them and traveled back to Olaris.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reldar Kandik was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Kandik appears on the Republic version of the planet Taris, where he gives Republic players the Heroic mission "Total Elimination".<ref name="TOR" />
